simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֵזֶק (H5143) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: נֵזֶק (nêzeq) means loss First listed occurrence: Esth 7 4.

definitions.full: H5143. nezeq [ נֶ֫זֶק ] noun [masculine] injury, damage (Aramaic loan-word see Biblical Aramaic); — only construct הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּנֶזֶק Est 7:4 at the price of injury to the king.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to injure ;
